fix: Only the root-order test changes: reverse rows in the same valid compact wire, retaining dictionary and bytes. The former decode/re-encode step was not a premise of the order-invariance assertion.
rerunReason: The one failed assertion used a conservative re-encoder near its byte ceiling. Only that failed case was rerun after correcting the fixture operation.
limitations: These are sequential checks, not a fresh all-green complete suite.
